column3: Robin was so afraid of being a burden, she tried to give herself up.
For twenty years, people who took her in had sold her out. So she made a deal. Herself, for her friends' safety.
Her crew came anyway. And Luffy shouted at her, to say she wants to live.
In one study, people had to ask a stranger to take their photo. The strangers were more willing, and far less bothered, than they expected.
Asking for help isn't taking something. It's letting someone show up for you.
